kontakt.tagline: We're a small Bratislava team turning the city's stories into objects with soul.

about.p1: We know Bratislava intimately — not from tourist guides, but from everyday walks, café conversations and the small details most people walk straight past. City Glory started with the urge to capture exactly those details and turn them into something you can hang on a wall, stick on a fridge, or wear.
about.p2: Behind every motif is a story — sometimes true, sometimes only half. About the people and events that shaped the city, and a few we've embellished just a little. Who knows, some might still come true.
about.p3: Beyond the products, you'll find articles and tips from people who genuinely know Bratislava — local guides, community projects, and details that might surprise you even if you've lived here your whole life.
about.p4: City Glory is a small team — Táňa, Jany, Ivo, Dominika and Miro. What we share is a love of graphic design and storytelling and, let's be honest, a mild obsession with detail. That's exactly the combination that goes into every product.
about.p5: Bratislava is only the beginning. We'd love to tell the same kind of stories about other cities one day — and you can help decide which one comes next.

preFirmyPage.intro: We love creating products with a unique identity — for companies looking for something exceptional, and for individuals after a graphic design of their own.

body.p1: Every custom product we make starts the same way our own motifs do — with a story. The place, brand or idea you want to capture becomes a graphic with us, and eventually an object you'll actually want to keep.
body.p2: We work with both companies and individuals. Sometimes it's client gifts carrying a brand's own identity, sometimes a single piece for someone who wants something truly their own at home or in the office. That's how we created custom motifs for Hotel Carlton, for instance, and more hotels and venues looking for their own visual identity with the city's soul keep joining in.
body.p3: The process is simple — we get to know your story, design a motif that captures it, and work out together which product it suits best. From t-shirts to magnets, tiles or prints.
body.p4: If you like one of our existing designs and would like something similar, but your own — for your brand, or just for yourself — get in touch. We'd love to take a look.
